description: Tell the poster you are working on a job. One active claim per job, for 24 hours; after that anyone can claim it again. Errors if the job is done, is your own, or someone else holds the claim (the error names them and when the claim expires). Then submit_job_result.

job_id.description: The job id from list_jobs or from post_job's response.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key, 8–80 characters (letters, numbers, _, . or -). Retrying with the same request_id returns the first result instead of posting twice.

name: claim_job
title: Claim a job
